caption: A bowl of fiery spicy ramen broth, rich and red, topped with chopped green onions and dark seasoning. The white ceramic bowl sits on a dark table, illuminated warmly, with a red spoon resting inside.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface, smooth and reflective, showing subtle grain patterns and soft ambient light reflections.
The spicy broth is vibrant orange-red, glossy, and filled with thin noodles, topped with chopped green onions and dark seasoning.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, slightly glossy surface and subtly curved, unadorned rim.
A glossy red spoon with smooth, curved surface and slightly tapered end, reflecting light subtly.
